description: This file provides utility functions related to JSON parsing, color handling, and error processing for the ai.openclaw.app.node package, including data class definitions and functions for converting strings to JSON and parsing JSON elements.

classes.name: Quad
classes.description: A generic data class representing a quadruple of values of types A, B, C, D.

methods.name: String.toJsonString
methods.description: Converts a string into a JSON-compatible string with escaped characters.

methods.name: JsonElement?.asObjectOrNull
methods.description: Safely casts a JsonElement to a JsonObject if possible, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: parseJsonParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, returning null if parsing fails or input is blank.

methods.name: readJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonPrimitive value associated with a key from a JsonObject.

methods.name: parseJsonInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value associated with a key from a JsonObject.

methods.name: parseJsonDouble
methods.description: Extracts a double value associated with a key from a JsonObject.

methods.name: parseJsonString
methods.description: Extracts a string value associated with a key from a JsonObject.

methods.name: parseJsonBooleanFlag
methods.description: Extracts a boolean flag from a JsonObject, interpreting 'true'/'false' strings.

methods.name: JsonElement?.asStringOrNull
methods.description: Returns the string content of a JsonElement if available, otherwise null.

methods.name: parseHexColorArgb
methods.description: Parses a hex color string into a Long representing ARGB color, defaulting to opaque if missing the alpha component.

methods.name: invokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a pair of code and message, using a specific parsing function.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Trims and validates a main key string, returning null if empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key string equals 'main'.
